name: Crocodile
appearance: An ordinary crocodile lying low in the water.

Encounters.name: Floating logs
Encounters.effectNote: Prodding the logs gives the party a 20% chance to spot the crocodile. If they pass without checking, it surprises them after the raft moves past. Their surprise rolls take a −2 penalty.

Encounters.name: At the raft edge
Encounters.effectNote: It targets a character near the edge of the raft, tries to pull them into the water, and flees once it has taken prey.

notes: One crocodile with 14 HP. Neutral. The print lists surprise as a special defense.
Bill Slavicsek, Night of the Walking Dead (TSR, 1992 print), Part I, The Swamp: The Crocodile, pp. 7–8.

name: Giant Frog
appearance: A broad giant frog four feet long and weighing about 150 pounds.

habitats: Reeds in the swamp feeding ground

Special attacks.name: Sticky tongue
Special attacks.effectNote: The tongue gains a +4 attack bonus and deals no damage. A hit pulls the target toward the frog’s bite.

Special attacks.name: Swallow whole
Special attacks.effectNote: On an attack roll of 20, a frog can swallow a Small victim whole, including a demihuman under four feet tall.

Encounters.name: Among the reeds
Encounters.effectNote: As the raft moves through the reeds, the party makes surprise rolls at −3. Three frogs emerge with 5, 8, and 10 HP respectively.

notes: The print lists alignment as Nil. XP 175 per frog.
Bill Slavicsek, Night of the Walking Dead (TSR, 1992 print), Part I, The Swamp: The Giant Frogs, p. 8.

name: Giant Bat
appearance: A large bat with broad leathery wings.

Special defenses.name: Airborne target
Special defenses.effectNote: Missile attacks against a giant bat take a −3 penalty while it is flying.

Encounters.name: Decrepit Mausoleum
Encounters.effectNote: Disturbing this tomb provokes 1d6 Giant Bats. Roll 1d4 HP for each bat.

notes: The print lists no Hit Dice, special attacks, or alignment. XP 35 per bat.
Bill Slavicsek, Night of the Walking Dead (TSR, 1992 print), Part III, Lair of the Zombie Lord: 4. Decrepit Mausoleum, p. 30.

name: Giant Rat
appearance: A giant rat that lives in the mausoleum vaults.

Special attacks.name: Disease
Special attacks.effectNote: The printed encounter names disease as a special attack and gives no procedure for it.

Encounters.name: Tomb of Rats
Encounters.effectNote: When the party enters the tomb, 3d6 rats leap from open vaults and attack. Roll 1d4 HP for each rat.

notes: Neutral evil. The print lists no Hit Dice or special defenses. XP 15 per rat.
Bill Slavicsek, Night of the Walking Dead (TSR, 1992 print), Part III, Lair of the Zombie Lord: 6. Tomb of Rats, p. 30.
